_comment: P18 save id map: IC2R legacy 1.20.1 -> IC2R 26.1.2.
Generated from docs/migration/registry-catalog.json (1199 entries: preserve=1198, replace=1).
Ids NOT listed here are preserved verbatim (1198/1199 catalog entries are decision=preserve,
old and new share the identifier), so the map only carries the deviations.
A block_entity value of "" means: drop the block entity from the chunk (the new mod implements
the behavior at block level and registers no block entity type with that id).
An item value of "" means: the item no longer exists in the port; the stack becomes air/0
and the removal is counted in the convert report (dropped).
inventory_map: legacy InvSlot name -> new slot index per machine. Standard electric machines
are INPUT 0 / OUTPUT 1 / BATTERY 2 with upgrades from slot 3 (CannerBlockEntity uses
ADDITIVE 0 / OUTPUT 1 / BATTERY 2 / CONTAINER 3 with upgrades from 4; tanks only carry 4
upgrade slots from 0). Entries are keyed by the LEGACY block-entity id wherever the BE was
replaced, so the converter's legacy-id fallback lookup stays authoritative.
Deferred pending slot-layout verification: miner (18 slots), block_cutter, fermenter,
condenser, electrolyzer and other non-standard families - their InvSlots are left in place
(forensic copy) and surface in the report's unmapped_slots instead of being guessed.
ic2:fluid_bottler drainInput is deliberately unmapped: the port canner has no drain slot.
